tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Health check for Gaming Wishlist (gift inspiration). Returns ok, storage, paapi, trackingTag/affiliateTag (null until real Associates IDs), marketplaces with tagConfigured. OpenAPI: getHealth.

tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List supported Amazon storefronts (domain, label, currencyHint, tagConfigured). Agents MUST pick the user's marketplace and pass it on search/catalog/resolve.

tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Search Amazon for gaming gear on the user's marketplace. Returns PA-API products when configured, otherwise gaming-filtered search deep-link cards. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. OpenAPI: searchAmazon.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Paginated curated gaming starters. Search (search_gifts) remains primary discovery. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to a buyUrl (also dual-writes affiliateUrl). Does not invent tracking tags — omits ?tag= until real IDs are configured. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale.

tools.name: create_wishlist
tools.description: Create a gaming wishlist. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl, wishlist, storage. Save editToken for add_item. Preferred one-shot: create_and_fill.

tools.name: create_and_fill
tools.description: One call: create a curated gamers (gaming gifts) gift wishlist and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. Preferred agent path: create a wishlist and add ASINs / keywords / search queries in one call. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl.

tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.description: Fetch a wishlist by id. Returns wishlist items with buyUrl/affiliateUrl and linkType when available, plus ownerUrl and shopUrl.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Add an item to a wishlist. Requires editToken from create. Body: name/title plus asin, url, searchKeywords, or catalogId.
